cnn_input: 120x12 completed-window 0.5-20Hz filtered signal, same sensors/samples as tabular models
threshold_change_note: This new declared comparison prioritizes FoG F1; rerun RF under the same new rule. Previous balanced-accuracy-threshold experiment is historical context only.

svm.score: sigmoid of decision margin; not probability calibration

cnn.normalization: Training windows only, per channel mean/std

selection_policy: One fixed configuration per model, no outer-test tuning. All results retained; project default not replaced automatically.
split_policy: Reuse frozen five outer participant folds; identical three inner participant folds for every model
preprocessing_policy: SVM scaler and CNN channel statistics fitted separately inside each training fold; no random-row calibration/early stopping
limitations: 22 participants; overlapping windows are not independent
Existing cohort already explored in the project
Single seed and fixed hyperparameters, not exhaustive model ranking
CNN is a same-input architecture comparison, not a reproduction of the published single-ankle CNN
